+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from click.utils import make_str
+
+
+def prepare(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate a record and return a new record with a display value."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not (key := key.strip()):
+        raise ValueError("key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value")
+
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("enabled must be a bool")
+
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": make_str(value), "enabled": enabled}

@@ -22,3 +22,20 @@ def prepare(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
 
     value = record["value"]
     return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": make_str(value), "enabled": enabled}
+
+
+def batch(records: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare a list of records, rejecting duplicate trimmed keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+
+    prepared = []
+    keys: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in keys:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {key!r}")
+        keys.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

         keys.add(key)
         prepared.append(item)
     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records: Any) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    """Group enabled display values by the first character of their key."""
+    groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return groups

+def merge(left: Any, right: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Merge prepared records, replacing matches without moving their keys."""
+    merged = {item["key"]: item for item in batch(left)}
+    merged.update((item["key"], item) for item in batch(right))
+    return list(merged.values())
